description: This file defines revocation checking mechanisms for SSL/TLS certificates, including policies, constants, and function declarations related to revocation status verification using CRL and OCSP protocols within the Chromium project.

classes.name: RevocationPolicy
classes.description: Struct defining policies for certificate revocation checking, including options for revocation checks, network access, CRL usage, and baseline enforcement.

methods.name: CheckValidatedChainRevocation
methods.description: Verifies the revocation status of a certificate chain according to a specified policy, updating errors and verification results.

methods.name: CheckChainRevocationUsingCRLSet
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate chain using a CRLSet, returning the revocation result and updating errors.
